name: Worldshepherd Gooey Gateway
purpose: Human-readable operating console for routing Worldshepherd work through Sara_Pro.

human_modules.name: Mission Dashboard
human_modules.plain_language: Shows whether Sara_Pro is alive, what services are active, and what needs attention.

human_modules.name: SARA Relay
human_modules.plain_language: Sends a controlled instruction from SARA_CORE to SSPADAWANZZ or another registered target.

human_modules.name: Audit Trail
human_modules.plain_language: Shows what happened, who triggered it, and when.

human_modules.name: Service Registry
human_modules.plain_language: Shows and updates the known services, agents, modules, and local state.

human_modules.name: Account Core
human_modules.plain_language: Stores and searches local Worldshepherd context, roles, notes, projects, agents, and imports.

human_modules.name: Adaptive Metasurface Control
human_modules.plain_language: Worldshepherd field-shaping work: RF tiles, phase/amplitude control, material tuning, sensing, feedback loops.

human_modules.name: Programmable Meta-Alloy
human_modules.plain_language: Worldshepherd material platform work around programmable deposited Al-Ti/meta-alloy systems.

human_modules.name: Protocol Library
human_modules.plain_language: BRD953, CRE1AWS 9675, Guardian, Morningstar, Dawnstar, Enochian, LawAbidingCitizen, and related protocol labels.

human_modules.name: Workflow Launcher
human_modules.plain_language: Runs allowed, safe Sara_Pro workflows through buttons instead of terminal-only commands.

sara_pro.name: Sara_Pro
sara_pro.human_summary: Local Worldshepherd/SARA interface running through FastAPI on port 9530.
safe_next_actions: Route all new Worldshepherd tasks through /console.

metasurface.name: Generic Adaptive Metasurface Control System
metasurface.human_summary: A hardware-control framework where each node is a reconfigurable EM/metamaterial tile with phase, amplitude, material, sensing, and feedback control.

meta_alloy.name: WS-AlTi M1-MSZ-Prime
meta_alloy.human_summary: Programmable deposited aluminum meta-alloy platform; commercial value depends on filing, modeling, coupon validation, and partner interest.

bsaradgs.name: BSARADGS
bsaradgs.human_summary: Corrected Worldshepherd acronym. Use BSARADGS unless later revised.

baros.name: BAROS
baros.human_summary: Radiotherapy optimization research framework. Treat as research/engineering until clinically validated.

allowed_workflows.name: Health Check
allowed_workflows.plain_language: Verify the local Sara_Pro service is alive.

allowed_workflows.name: Admin Self-Test
allowed_workflows.plain_language: Run internal checks for tokens, registry, audit directory, and registered services.

allowed_workflows.name: Relay Ping
allowed_workflows.plain_language: Send a controlled test relay from SARA_CORE to SSPADAWANZZ.

allowed_workflows.name: Export Account Core
allowed_workflows.plain_language: Export the local Worldshepherd account-core manifest.

allowed_workflows.name: Reindex Account Core
allowed_workflows.plain_language: Rebuild the searchable index for local Worldshepherd context.

security_rules: No arbitrary shell execution from the browser.
Never expose .env tokens in screenshots or PDFs.
Use SARA_RELAY_TOKEN only for relay/operator actions.
